key_insight: EHRNote-ChatQA is a new benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded clinical question answering over longitudinal discharge summaries, not just single-note or exam-style QA.
clinical_relevance: It better reflects how clinicians review multiple discharge summaries and verify supporting evidence when making follow-up care and diagnostic decisions.
method: Built from de-identified MIMIC-IV discharge summaries spanning 1 to 5 notes per patient
Used expert-informed note structuring, curated multi-turn QA templates, and LLM-assisted generation
Every QA sample was reviewed and revised by 11 medical experts
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 967 patient-level samples and 16,072 expert-verified QA pairs across eight clinical categories, and evaluation of 22 LLMs showed evidence grounding is harder than content answering.
watch_item: Performance on this benchmark may not transfer from standard single-turn clinical QA, and the dataset requires PhysioNet credentialed access.
paper_title: EHRNote-ChatQA: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Turn Clinical Question Answering over Longitudinal Discharge Summaries
